debugger_continue.name: debugger_continue
debugger_continue.title: Continue debugger
debugger_continue.description: Continues the current stopped debugger context. The target remains stopped when no broken context exists.

continued.description: Whether Cheat Engine accepted the continuation request.

debugger_get_context.name: debugger_get_context
debugger_get_context.title: Get debugger context
debugger_get_context.description: Copies normalised registers from the current stopped context; integer registers are uppercase hexadecimal without 0x. Include extra registers only when FPU or XMM values matter: Cheat Engine then supplies FP0-FP7 (10 bytes each) and XMM0-XMM15 (16 bytes each; XMM0-XMM7 on 32-bit targets) as byte arrays, returned as space-separated hexadecimal bytes in memory order, least significant byte first.

includeExtraRegisters.description: Include the FPU (FP0-FP7) and XMM registers where Cheat Engine exposes them, as space-separated hexadecimal bytes.

is64Bit.description: Whether the target is 64-bit according to Cheat Engine.

registers.description: Uppercase register names mapped to text: integer registers as uppercase hexadecimal without 0x; byte-array registers such as FP0-FP7 and XMM0-XMM15 as space-separated hexadecimal bytes in memory order, least significant byte first; any other value as bounded text.

includesExtraRegisters.description: Whether FPU and XMM registers were requested; they appear in registers only where Cheat Engine supplied them.

debugger_get_stack_trace.name: debugger_get_stack_trace
debugger_get_stack_trace.title: Get heuristic stack trace
debugger_get_stack_trace.description: Scans at most 128 stack slots of the current stopped context for values after a call instruction. Every frame is heuristic: verify candidates with code_disassemble before treating them as callers.

depth.description: The stack slots to inspect, from 1 through 128.

stackPointer.description: The stack pointer read from the broken context, uppercase hexadecimal without 0x.

pointerSize.description: The pointer width used to scan stack slots.

frames.description: Candidate call-return frames in stack order.

stackAddress.description: The address of the stack slot containing the candidate, uppercase hexadecimal without 0x.

returnAddress.description: The candidate return address, uppercase hexadecimal without 0x.

callInstruction.description: The instruction immediately before returnAddress when Cheat Engine could disassemble one.

isHeuristic.description: Always true: stale stack values and non-call code pointers can produce false frames.

scannedSlots.description: The number of stack slots examined.

debugger_get_status.name: debugger_get_status
debugger_get_status.title: Get debugger status
debugger_get_status.description: Reads Cheat Engine's debugger state. broken is proven by obtaining the context and is more reliable than reportedBroken alone. Poll after debugger_break_thread because a break request is asynchronous.

stateValid.description: Whether Cheat Engine returned a complete debugger-state snapshot.

canBreak.description: Whether Cheat Engine currently permits a break request.

broken.description: Whether debug_getContext proved that a broken context is available.

reportedBroken.description: The separate state reported by debug_isBroken.

stepping.description: Whether Cheat Engine reports that it is single stepping.

activeInterface.description: The active debugger interface when attached.

error.description: A bounded host message when the state could not be read.

debugger_step.name: debugger_step
debugger_step.title: Step debugger
debugger_step.description: Steps into or over one instruction from the current stopped context.

mode.description: into follows a call; over runs a call to its return.

continued.description: Whether Cheat Engine accepted the continuation request.
